# Eleazar Madera (Ele) — Front-End Developer

> Portfolio of Eleazar Madera, a front-end developer with 10+ years of experience engineering brands, campaigns and the websites that carry them. Open to front-end and full-stack roles, freelance projects, and collaborations. Site: https://uxele.dev

The site is a single page (React). This file summarizes it in plain text for AI assistants and crawlers that don't run JavaScript.

## About

- For over a decade, Ele has worked at the intersection of brand, design, and code: building visual identities, marketing systems, and the websites that bring them to life.
- Has collaborated with global teams across multiple countries and cultures, helping companies establish and grow their presence in new markets.
- Earlier, as Multimedia Manager at MotionPoint, worked directly with clients to globalize their websites, helping increase conversion rates by 20–40% on average.
- Bilingual: English and Spanish.
- Highlights: 5K+ hours of team collaboration, 100+ projects in 5 domains, 10+ years of experience.

## Skills

- Development: React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, WordPress, GSAP animation, WebGL.
- Design: brand identity and logo design, marketing collateral and sales presentations, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma.
- Digital content: photography and video production, web media optimization and performance.
- Soft skills: international experience, teamwork, self-guided, clear communication with clients and stakeholders, translating business goals into design decisions, mentoring, managing projects from brief to launch.

## Selected projects (case studies on the site)

- Siraya (Cloud Infrastructure & CDN, www.sirayatech.com): brand, website and APAC growth — 600+ clients in 18 months.
- SIRAYA.AI Models (AI / LLM API platform, www.siraya.ai/models): AI model catalog with live filtering.
- Deltabase (Cloud Infrastructure & CDN, www.deltabase.vn): full brand and website in two weeks.
- Mega Hard Limited (Network Infrastructure & Security, www.megahardlimited.com): a brand built for the security and gaming niche.
- MileWeb → Quantil → CDNetworks (Content Delivery Network, www.cdnetworks.com): eight years, three names, one brand journey across Asia-Pacific.

## About this website

- Built by Ele with React, Vite and Tailwind CSS, animated with GSAP, hosted on Cloudflare Workers.
- The homepage hero is a scroll-driven video drawn on a WebGL canvas, with live animated stars in dark mode.
